basic_info.description:
Welcome to 618 19th Avenue, a spacious 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath Edwardian home brimming with timeless character and incredible opportunity. Nestled in the heart of San Franciscos desirable Richmond District, this 1900 sq. ft. residence sits on a generous 3,000 sq. ft. lot, offering a rare chance to restore and reimagine a true classic.
Stepping inside, you'll find period details that echo the craftsmanship of a bygone era - a brick fireplace, rich hardwood floors, and built-in cabinetry. The grand living and dining rooms set the stage for elegant entertaining, while the bright kitchen awaits your modern vision. Upstairs, three spacious bedrooms and a full bath provide ample space, with an additional half bath on the main level. The deep backyard offers plenty of room for outdoor living, gardening, or future expansion.
Just moments from Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach, and an array of shops and restaurants along Geary Blvd and Clement Street, this home combines charm, convenience, and potential. Whether you're looking to renovate, expand, or create your dream home, dont miss your chance to bring this Richmond District gem back to life!
